caption: The drawing features a single, centrally positioned object that appears to be a vase or urn with two handles. The vase is colored in various shades of blue and purple, with lighter highlights suggesting a glossy surface and reflections. The vase has a wide, flared rim, a narrow neck, a rounded and bulging body, and a flared base. Each side of the body has one handle that curves outward and then downward before connecting back to the body. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or patterns, and the vase is isolated in the center of the composition.
title: Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
